dedupeText: retro wave pattern album art scallop pattern retro typography textured waves 70s aesthetic geometric abstraction the wave pattern occupies the bottom two thirds of the frame the typography is anchored in the top right and center left of the negative space a thick black border frames the entire square composition combine a rhythmic geometric pattern in the lower half with a textured cream header and heavy 70s display typography to create a vintage inspired layout

recipe.visualDefinition: A retro-inspired composition featuring a dense, overlapping scallop or fish-scale pattern representing waves, topped by a cream-colored sky containing bold, stylized 1970s-style lettering and a secondary line of sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: The wave pattern occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
The typography is anchored in the top-right and center-left of the negative space.
A thick black border frames the entire square composition.
coreInvariants: Distressed, grainy paper texture across all elements
Heavy drop shadows on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The wave pattern is the dominant visual subject, scaled to fill the lower 65% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized script in the top right acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large script, moves left to the subtitle, then flows down into the rhythmic repetition of the waves.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A cream-colored rectangular area at the top provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background for the upper third.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues, teals, and purples in the lower wave sections.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm oranges, yellows, and reds in the middle wave transition and the primary text fill.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center of the pattern, fading to darker values at the bottom and lighter values at the top.
paletteRestrictions: Must include a mix of cool ocean tones and warm sunset tones.
Black is used strictly for outlines, shadows, and the outer frame.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Round, fluid script with interlocking characters.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy black offset drop shadow to the bottom-left
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' characters feature exaggerated loops that connect to adjacent letters.
The 'y' has a long, sweeping descender that underlines part of the word.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floats in the negative space above the waves
Separates the display text from the pattern

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a fluid, organic script and a rigid, geometric sans-serif.

preserve: The interlocking nature of the script
The specific color transition of the waves

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Motter Tektura or similar 70s display faces
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, thick-stroke retro feel.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square graphic with a thick black border. The bottom two-thirds features a repeating scallop pattern resembling waves, with colors transitioning from dark purple and blue at the bottom to orange and teal in the middle, and light blue at the top. The top third is a solid cream color with a grainy, distressed paper texture applied to the whole image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, stylized 70s-style script in golden yellow with a heavy black drop shadow in the top right. Below it and to the left, add a single line of all-caps geometric sans-serif text in dark maroon with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Does the wave pattern have a visible grain/texture?
Is the primary text interlocking and rounded?
Is there a clear color transition from warm to cool in the pattern?
Is the composition framed by a thick black border?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the drop shadow on the script is solid black and offset.
Check that the scallop shapes overlap correctly to create the wave effect.
Verify the texture is consistent across both the pattern and the negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rhythmic geometric pattern in the lower half with a textured cream header and heavy 70s display typography to create a vintage-inspired layout.
